# ScaleForge

> ScaleForge is a high-performance digital agency specialising in web design, web development, SEO, AI automation, content creation, and social media marketing for ambitious businesses.

Website: https://scaleforge.agency
Contact: scaleforgebusiessdev@gmail.com
Book a call: https://cal.com/shahood-saleem-gbzisb/30min

## About

ScaleForge builds pixel-perfect websites, high-intent SEO architectures, and AI automation systems that compound a business's authority and efficiency month after month. The agency works primarily with founders, growing SMEs, and established brands in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the EU.

Core belief: most agencies ship templates, disappear, and leave clients with slow, bloated sites invisible on Google. ScaleForge is the antidote — engineering-first, results-obsessed, and built for the long game.

## Services

- **AI Automation & Development** — Custom n8n, Make.com, and Zapier workflows; Vapi AI cold-call agents; AI content engines; lead enrichment and CRM sync pipelines.
- **Web Design** — Conversion-focused UI/UX design in Figma; landing pages; brand identity alignment.
- **Web Development** — Next.js App Router builds; Sanity CMS integration; e-commerce; performance and security hardening.
- **SEO** — Keyword research; on-page and technical SEO; link building; Google Search Console management; local SEO.
- **Content Creation** — SEO blog articles; commercial landing pages; pillar guides; brand copywriting; E-E-A-T compliant writing.
- **Social Media Marketing** — Multi-platform management; branded graphics; Reels/TikTok scripts; community management; paid social ad creative.

## Pricing

Transparent, tier-based pricing — no hidden fees, no lock-in contracts.

- AI Automation: $1,200 – $7,500+ per project
- Web Design & Development: $1,800 – $9,500+ per project
- SEO: $650 – $3,200 / month
- Content Creation: $900 – $4,800 / month
- Social Media Marketing: $750 – $3,800 / month
- All-in-One Growth Bundles: $3,800 – $14,500+ / month
